race.comment: CASTELLI IN ARIA (5) had many trials in the lead up to her first up run and she was a solid second in that. This maiden won't be much tougher. Could potentially want a wetter track so monitor the conditions. EXPANDING POWER (6) had to make up a lot of ground when racing at Cranbourne. She draws a low barrier here as well so should not need to give away that much track position. PINAZAKI (10) led and only just missed two weeks ago. This is harder but could get into the placings. OUR BRUD (9) wears blinkers straight into his career. Bred to want every bit of this and more.
